name: engineering-dsl
description: Engineering DSL notebook highlighting, glyph completions and transformed syntax checking.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting is available; the Python checker and kernel installation require workspace trust.

engineeringDsl.pythonPath.description: Python executable with engineering-dsl and IPython installed. Empty uses the registered local DSL kernel's interpreter, then the Python extension's selection, then python on PATH.

engineeringDsl.runtimePath.description: Optional engineering-dsl checkout root (containing utils). Automatically discovered for notebooks inside the checkout.

engineeringDsl.diagnostics.description: Check transformed DSL syntax without executing notebook cells. This is syntax checking, not Pylance type analysis.

engineeringDsl.syntaxMode.description: Initial syntax mode used by the editor checker. Literal set_syntax_mode calls and %%dsl headers override it.
